name: waggle-os
description: Waggle OS is a workspace-native AI agent platform with persistent memory, model-agnostic orchestration, and skill-extensible capabilities, delivered as a Tauri desktop app (React 19 + Vite) with a Fastify Node.js sidecar over an npm monorepo. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
